values.description: Local Docker Compose or `npm run start:dev` endpoint.

Bearer API key (starts with `ppk_`). Issue one with `npm run key:issue -- --tenant <tnt_...> --scopes models:read,models:write,simulations:run,simulations:read,exports:read,audit:read`. NEVER commit a real key.
Default: the seeded demo model. Overwritten automatically by the Create model request.
Default: the seeded demo simulation. Overwritten automatically by the Create simulation request.
Captured from Get model detail; used by the optional If-Match header on Create model version.
Optional: key with models:read only — enables the 403 forbidden_scope scenario. Empty = scenario skips.
Optional: a model id belonging to ANOTHER tenant — enables the true cross-tenant isolation scenario. Empty = unknown-id fallback (same 404 envelope).
Set to true to enable the opt-in 429 rate-limit burst scenario (kept off by default so normal runs stay fast).
